title: 第5章 雕刻鬼婴开始炫技第6章 偷师技艺天才少女的惊讶
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
大雪如瀑，寒风料峭！
冰冷至极，宛如刮骨刀！
当李浪来到唐氏雕工铺，背篓里早已积了不少雪，清理完积雪后，李浪摘下斗笠，进入到铺子里。
铺子里倒是没有想象中那么闹哄哄，反而很安静，学徒们一个个都紧张的雕刻着，正在准备着考核前最后的抱佛脚。
李浪进来的时候，也没有多少人在乎。
今日之后，这一批学徒，将会被筛选掉不少，年龄到十七岁，却未能成为正式雕师，就无法再留在铺子里。
而铺子也会招收新的学徒，换上新鲜血液。
李浪进入自己的工房，安静的等待起来。
片刻，有敲锣声音炸开，管事开始呼喊学徒们汇聚，准备考核。
报名参加考核的学徒们，齐聚一起。
李浪也走出工房，与其他背着背篓的学徒们，一起跟随管事，朝着考核大堂走去。
刚入大堂门户，就止住了步伐。
宽敞无比的大堂中，炭炉中，烧红的炭火，散发出温暖，驱散了冬日严寒。
而大堂中，早已有不少人影汇聚。
咕噜噜……
碳炉上，架着茶炉，热水在其中滚沸，碧绿茶叶撒入其中，舒展腰肢，浓郁茶香弥漫。
唐氏雕工铺负责雕师考核的二掌柜唐花柳，正端坐太师椅上，与两位铺子里的雕工大师，一边饮茶，一边有说有笑。
唐老三则是坐在侧畔，满脸堆笑。
大堂中，早有两位学徒到达，一人便是唐宇，身躯肥胖，脸上挂着人畜无害的憨笑。
而另外一人，乃是位身姿曼妙的少女，穿一袭红裙，戴着红色的面纱，唯有眸子晶莹明亮，整个人宛如冬日盛放的赤色梧桐花，极其吸睛。

至少，李浪一踏入大堂，便被那如火般的少女给吸引了目光。
倪嫣！
本次参加考核的十五位雕工学徒中，占据一个名额的少女，听闻早就被云霄城天工坊中的一位鬼神雕大师给收为亲传！
此女在木雕技艺上，远超过他李浪，所以，没有坏他木雕的动机。
因此……李浪眼帘低垂，闪过一抹冷意。
猜也能猜到，坏他木雕的……大抵就是这位唐宇了。
唐氏雕工铺三掌柜唐春明的第六个儿子，也是最小的儿子。
此人嫌疑最大！
唐宇看都不看李浪，很显然，在坏了李浪木雕作品后，唐宇对于自己的作品，已经是极有自信！
“这位是云霄城天工阁的周执事，咱们雕工铺的正式雕师考核，将在周执事的见证下完成。”
二掌柜唐花柳见人都到齐后，介绍了下身边陪伴饮茶的雕工大师。
而另一位雕工大师，便是叶金宝了。
唐花柳站起身，身上华服贴身，勾勒出强壮的身材，而他的脖颈处，隐晦有淡黑色的花纹，如藤蔓般缠绕蔓延出些许。
鬼神纹！
李浪下意识的看了一眼，只感觉心神一颤，仿佛那纹络活过来般，慢慢膨胀，在唐花柳的背后，形成一尊扭曲怪异的鬼神虚影！
一股莫名的恐惧压落心头，好似灵魂都在颤栗，让他赶忙挪开视线。
“本次考核，总共有两个流程。”
“一个是考验你们的雕工，另一个便是评估你们呕心沥血雕刻的作品。”
“你们的木雕作品，周执事和叶大师，会给你们分析木雕上的不足与瑕疵，继而给木雕作品打分。”
“加上雕工的考核评分，总分最高的二人可以跻身正式雕师，这是咱们唐氏雕工铺一直以来的规矩，最是公平，全靠本事说话，哪怕是我的儿子，想要成为正式雕师，也同样要经历这场考核。”

唐花柳负手，眸光扫视屋子里的所有学徒。
“现在，开始考核的第一场。”
content_en:
The snow is like a waterfall and the wind is freezing!
Extremely cold, like a bone scraper!
When Li Lang arrived at Tang's Carving Shop, a lot of snow had already accumulated in his basket. After clearing the snow, Li Lang took off his bamboo hat and entered the shop.
The shop was not as noisy as expected, but very quiet. The apprentices were all carving nervously, preparing for the final cramming before the assessment.
When Li Lang came in, not many people cared.
After today, many of these apprentices will be screened out. Those who reach the age of seventeen but fail to become official carvers will no longer be able to stay in the shop.
The shop will also recruit new apprentices and replace them with fresh blood.
Li Lang entered his workshop and waited quietly.
After a moment, the sound of gongs was heard, and the steward began to call the apprentices to gather together and prepare for the assessment.
The apprentices who signed up for the assessment gathered together.
Li Lang also walked out of the workshop and followed the steward towards the assessment hall with the other apprentices carrying backpacks.
As soon as he entered the lobby entrance, he stopped in his tracks.
In the extremely spacious lobby, the red-hot charcoal fire in the charcoal stove exudes warmth and dispels the severe cold in winter.
In the lobby, many people have already gathered.
Gululu...
On the charcoal stove, there is a tea stove, hot water is boiling in it, green tea leaves are sprinkled into it, the waist is stretched, and the rich fragrance of tea fills the air.
Tang Hualiu, the second shopkeeper of Tang's Carving Shop who is in charge of carving examinations, is sitting upright on the grand master's chair, drinking tea and laughing with the two master carvers in the shop.
Tang Laosan was sitting on the side with a smile on his face.
In the lobby, two apprentices had arrived early. One of them was Tang Yu. He was fat and had a harmless smile on his face.
The other person is a graceful girl, wearing a red dress and a red veil. Only her eyes are crystal clear. Her whole person is like a red sycamore flower blooming in winter, which is extremely eye-catching.
At least, as soon as Li Lang stepped into the lobby, he was attracted by the fiery girl.
Ni Yan!
Among the fifteen carving apprentices who participated in the assessment this time, the girl who occupied one spot had been accepted as a direct successor by a ghost carving master in the Tiangongfang of Yunxiao City!
This woman's wood carving skills far surpassed Li Lang's, so she had no intention of ruining his wood carving.
Therefore... Li Lang lowered his eyes, a flash of coldness flashing through his eyes.
You can guess that the person who ruined his wood carving... was probably Tang Yu.
The sixth son and youngest son of Tang Chunming, the third shop owner of Tang's Carving Shop.
This person is the most suspicious!
Tang Yu didn't even look at Li Lang. It was obvious that after destroying Li Lang's wood carvings, Tang Yu was extremely confident in his own works!
"This is Deacon Zhou from Tiangong Pavilion in Yunxiao City. The official carver assessment of our carving shop will be completed under the witness of Deacon Zhou."
When the second shopkeeper, Tang Hualiu, saw that everyone had arrived, he introduced the master carver who was accompanying him while drinking tea.
And another master carver is Ye Jinbao.
Tang Hualiu stood up, his luxurious clothes were close to his body, outlining his strong figure, and on his neck, there were faint black patterns, twisting and spreading like vines.
Ghost pattern!
Li Lang glanced subconsciously and felt his heart tremble, as if the lines came to life and slowly expanded, forming a twisted and weird shadow of ghosts and gods behind Tang Hualiu!
An inexplicable fear overwhelmed his heart, as if his soul was trembling, causing him to quickly look away.
"This assessment has a total of two processes."
"One is to test your carving skills, and the other is to evaluate the works you have worked so hard to carve."
"Deacon Zhou and Master Ye will analyze the shortcomings and flaws of your wood carvings for you, and then give you a score for the wood carvings."
"In addition to the carving assessment scores, the two people with the highest total scores can become official carvers. This has always been the rule of our Tang's Carving Shop. It is the most fair and everyoneSpeaking of ability, even if my son wants to become an official carver, he still has to go through this test. "
Tang Hualiu put his hands behind his hands and scanned all the apprentices in the room.
“Now, let’s start the first round of the assessment. "
